name: NumberedList
title: NumberedList
summary: Ordered content in two forms: large numbered rows (01, 02) for programmes and beliefs, and compact numbered steps (1, 2) for how-it-works instructions.
whenToUse: Numbered rows `.dp-numlist`: Mission & Vision, Statement of Faith, Publishing programmes, anything where each item has a title and one line of explanation.
Numbered steps `.dp-steps`: short sequences the reader follows, like the NFC card "How it works" or getting started with the dot.Bible app.
whenNotToUse: Do not number items that have no order or rank; use ListRow or a Card grid.
Do not use for more than about six items; split into sections.

props.name: variant
props.description: `rows`: large two-digit numerals (01, 02) for programmes and beliefs. `steps`: compact circled digits for how-it-works.

props.name: items
props.description: The items, in order. Keep to about six.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level of each item title, to fit the page outline.

variantNotes: Numbered rows: white card, `--gray-200` border, `--radius-lg`, 32px × 40px padding; hairlines between rows; 32px `--horizon-blue-dim` numerals, two digits.
Numbered steps: `--gray-100` panel, 20px gap; 32px `--charcoal-900` circles with white numerals.
Mobile: both reduce padding to 24px; row numerals wrap above the text when space runs out.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Use a real `<ol>` and hide the visual numeral from assistive tech (`aria-hidden="true"`); the list provides the number.
Rows use two-digit numerals (01, 02); steps use single digits (1, 2).
Numerals in rows are `--horizon-blue-dim` text, never a Horizon Blue fill.
One title and at most two short sentences per item.
Do not put buttons inside items; put one action after the list.

accessibility: The `<ol>` announces "list, 3 items" and each position, so the hidden numeral is not read twice.
Item titles are headings at the right level for the page (usually `h3`).
Keep text contrast: `.muted` (`--gray-700`) on white and on `--gray-100` both pass AA.
content: Rows: "Digital — the dot.Bible app directory" / "Free Bible apps, searchable by language."; "Audio — HD radio broadcasts" / "Scripture readings on the airwaves."
Steps start with a verb: "Unlock the phone", "Tap the card", "Open the link".
